description: This file defines the main application view for a TodoMVC app using Backbone.js. It manages rendering, event handling, and interactions with the Todo collection.

classes.name: app.AppView
classes.description: Main view class for the TodoMVC application, handling rendering, user interactions, and collection events.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Updates the UI to reflect the current state of the Todo collection, including statistics and filter selection.

methods.name: addOne
methods.description: Creates and appends a view for a single Todo item.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds all Todo items to the list view.

methods.name: filterOne
methods.description: Triggers visibility update for a single Todo item.

methods.name: filterAll
methods.description: Applies filtering to all Todo items.

methods.name: newAttributes
methods.description: Generates attributes for creating a new Todo item.

methods.name: createOnEnter
methods.description: Creates a new Todo item when Enter key is pressed in input.

methods.name: toggleAllComplete
methods.description: Marks all Todo items as completed or not based on the toggle.
